entities.name: New Freedom
entities.description: Underground dwarven settlement on Ulgrotha, later conquered by Baron Sengir and turned into Castle Sengir.

entities.name: Dwarven Gate
entities.description: Planar portal the dwarves used to reach Ulgrotha; it stopped working after the Mending.

entities.name: Dwarves
entities.description: Settlers who built New Freedom after leaving their world through the Dwarven Gate.

entities.name: Irini Sengir
entities.description: Daughter of the dwarven king of New Freedom, captured by the Baron.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Vampire who conquered New Freedom and its castle.

entities.name: Castle of Morning Light
entities.description: Castle built above New Freedom, conquered and renamed Castle Sengir.

entities.name: Ihsan
entities.description: Left Ulgrotha with Sengir through the Dwarven Gate.

entities.name: Grandmother Sengir
entities.description: Remained on Ulgrotha and helped defend it against the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: Event after which the Dwarven Gate stopped working.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion Grandmother Sengir helped defend the plane against.

events.summary: Baron Sengir conquers New Freedom and its castle, which becomes Castle Sengir.
events.quote: New Freedom and the castle were conquered by Baron Sengir and became Castle Sengir .

events.summary: In 4500, on the eve of the Mending, Sengir, Ihsan and a host of vampires leave the plane through the Dwarven Gate.
events.quote: Sengir, Ihsan , and a large host of vampires , went through the Dwarven Gate, leaving the plane behind

events.summary: Grandmother Sengir stays behind and helps defend Ulgrotha against the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Grandmother Sengir remained behind on the plane

relations.quote: New Freedom was an underground dwarven settlement that the dwarves built
